name: fielddraft
description: Draft itemized quotes from a job-site description using the contractor's own Jobber price book, then push them to Jobber.

interface.longDescription: Quoting tool for trades contractors who use Jobber. FieldDraft turns a contractor's description of a job (what they saw at the panel, the run length, the equipment) into an itemized draft quote built only from their own Jobber products & services. Lines with no price book match are flagged instead of priced. Review the draft beside the conversation, then push it into Jobber as a quote to send from there. Built for 1-5 truck electrical and HVAC shops.
defaultPrompt: Draft a quote: 200A panel upgrade, meter on the left side, 30 ft of conduit to the garage for a 50A EV charger circuit.
What do I charge for a 50A EV charger circuit?
